title: A Gatherer’s Adventure in Isekai
description: Kamishiro Takeru is a completely ordinary salaryman who reincarnates in another world—a world of swords and magic called Madeus—and starts his new isekai life with lots of new skills! Takeru must make the most of his enhanced physical strength, unbelievable magic power, and the “Search” ability that allows him to find items of worth as his great isekai journey begins!

episodes_data.title: A Gatherer’s Adventure in Isekai Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Takeru comes to the artisan district in search of scissors to use in gathering materials, and meets an apprentice blacksmith named Libur. Takeru offers to gather the "Ildra Stone" that his master desires in exchange for making him a pair of scissors for himself, and heads for the Liuhai Mine. On the way, he encounters the unfortunate elf Brolite.

episodes_data.description: Takeru and the group are looking for River Arina to save the high elves. To look for a clue on their whereabouts, they headed to the Kieto Hollow. As they enter the cave, they encounter many poisonous monsters.
